item.title: Version 3.10.1
item.description:
neoloopy 3.10.1 (build 63)

A small follow-up to 3.10.0 from a click-through of the shipped build. Everything in the [3.10.0 notes](3.10.0.md) still applies, including the one-time neoloopy index build after upgrading from 3.9.1.

Scope

  • macOS. The macOS app (DMG and Sparkle update) with the embedded neoloopy CLI and MCP server. Windows, Linux and Android builds are not part of this release, and the iOS app is not part of this cut.

In the app

  • The structure board shows every facet chip. The Types and Groups chip pane of a Graph Model's structure board now sizes to the window instead of a fixed height, so a tall window shows every row whole and a short one still scrolls. Before, a window of ordinary height cut the last Groups row through the middle of the chips.
  • Check for updates moved to the More menu. It sits next to Install neoloopy CLI with the other app-level actions, instead of under the vault path chevron with the folder actions.

Updating

  • The update prompt shows the release notes. The appcast item now carries them, so Sparkle's prompt says what changed rather than only that something did. The 3.10.0 item was republished the same way.
